integrity: A complete analytic proof accompanies exact-rational reproducibility checks of the algebra; numerical tests do not establish infinite-parameter claims.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary-area A^2 of the unit disk and constant first-order evaluation jets are classified. The boundary polynomial is a limiting device, not a kernel value at the disk boundary; there is no higher-jet, weighted, general-domain, or transported-coefficient assertion. Mathematical priority beyond checked literature is not established.
title: First-order Bergman jet kernels on the disk have a sharp zero-free dichotomy
